description: Validate an IBAN (ISO 13616 length, mod-97 and national BBAN rules) and return the country, bank code, branch, bank name and BIC where the bundled registry knows it, SEPA membership, compact and printed forms. Example: 'AE070331234567890123456'. Response: result plus data_confidence (high = check-digit algorithm from a public specification; medium = community-documented checksum or pattern-only; low = structure only), estimated_items[], sources[], data_version and a disclaimer (structural validation only — never proof that an identifier is issued or belongs to someone).

iban.description: IBAN with or without spaces, e.g. 'AE07 0331 2345 6789 0123 456'.
iban.title: Iban
